items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There are people like Doc Cheatham and Money Johnson. But there are very few left. Pat Jenkins. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I know. Yes, it gets scarce.

ctx.x: My wife now, Pat? I met her on 125th Street when I was living in the Teresa.
She wasn't, was she in show business?
